proposals.content_angle: Explains when police may impound (tạm giữ) a motorbike under Article 48 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP: impoundment before a penalty decision for listed offences, among them riding without a valid licence or with an International Driving Permit but without the national licence (Article 18(5)), riding without a registration certificate or with plate problems (Article 14(2)(a)-(b) and 14(3)(a)), any alcohol level, drugs or refusing a test (Article 7(6)(a), 7(8)(b), 7(9)) and entering an expressway (Article 7(7)(b)); impoundment of vehicle and papers to secure enforcement (Article 48(2)); what happens when papers cannot be shown at a check, including documents integrated in the electronic identification account and the appointment deadline (Article 48(3)); costs borne by the owner (Article 48(4)); the papers to carry under Article 56 of Law 36/2024/QH15; and practical steps for renters such as calling the shop and keeping the violation record, without stating impoundment durations.
entities: retenção do veículo (tạm giữ phương tiện)
